basic_details.job_title: CSIR CFTRI Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute, Mysuru (CSIR CFTRI) has notified 1 temporary vacancy for the post of Project Associate Level-II. The temporary engagement is initially for a period up to SIX months and may be extendable up to March 2028 or project duration. The notified pay is Rs. 35,000 plus HRA. Candidates applying for the post must hold a Masters in Biotechnology/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Molecular Biology/Genetics or related subject with 2 years experience and NET/GATE, or a Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology (Bioengineering or Biotechnology). content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Project Associate Level-II at a Glance

rows.details: CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute, Mysuru
CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute (CSIR), Mysuru, Karnataka
Understanding the molecular basis for the utilization of non- fructosylated α-GOS (manninotriose and verbascotetraose) in human gut probiotics
Sponsored by sponsoring agency (Project Number: FIR070407)
Initially up to six months; extendable up to March 2028 or project duration

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the essential qualifications, age limits, and experience requirements to apply for the Project Associate Level-II position. Age Limit: Candidates should not have exceeded 35 years of age as on 15.10.2026. Relaxation in age limit for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates is 05 years and for OBC category is 03 years.

rows.essential_qualification: Masters in Biotechnology /Microbiology/ Biochemistry/ Molecular Biology/ Genetics or related subject from recognized University AND 2 years' experience in R&D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science & Technology Organizations with National Eligibility Tests (CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET including lectureship/assistant professorship or GATE or those who have qualified National level examinations conducted by Central Government/departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and/or their Agencies/Institutions) OR Masters / Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology (Bioengineering or Biotechnology) from a recognized University.
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience in recombinant DNA techniques, enzyme assays, enzyme purification and characterization, oligosaccharide identification, and structural elucidation using analytical techniques.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Project Associate Level-II incumbent will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 35,000/- plus HRA. The engagement is purely on a temporary contractual basis on behalf of the sponsoring agency and is co-terminus with the project tenure or up to March 2028, whichever is earlier. As per CSIR OM dated 02.09.2024, the total engagement period of a Project Staff across different CSIR labs shall not exceed 6 years in any case. Applicants who have already completed a total tenure of 6 years as Project Staff in any CSIR Lab/Instititute are not eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR CFTRI Project Associate Level-II
content_sections.text: Visit the official online application portal at https://patcell.cftri.res.in . Submit the online application form along with necessary attachments of certificates supporting date of birth, caste, qualification, and experience on or before 15.10.2026. Ensure that no other mode of application is used, as offline or delayed applications after 15.10.2026 will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted by a designated committee based on current requirements, percentage of marks in essential qualifications, higher educational qualifications, or desirable experience. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, and details will be posted on the CSIR-CFTRI website. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Project Associate Level-II post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a temporary contractual basis. It is initially for up to six months and may be extendable up to March 2028 or until the end of the project duration, whichever is earlier, co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any allowances or HRA paid on top of the stipend?
faq.answer: Yes, the selected candidate receives a monthly stipend of Rs. 35,000/- plus HRA as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. Who receives age relaxation, and what is the extent of relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is applicable for candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwBD, Women, and OBC categories. SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates receive a relaxation of 05 years, and OBC candidates receive a relaxation of 03 years.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Applicants are shortlisted by a designated committee using criteria such as percentage of marks in essential qualifications, higher educational qualifications than prescribed, desirable qualifications/experience, or other methods deemed fit by the committee.

faq.question: Q5. Who is not eligible to apply for this engagement?
faq.answer: Candidates with result-awaited or appearing final semesters, those who have completed a total tenure of 6 years as Project Staff in any CSIR Lab/Institute, and those lacking the essential educational qualifications and experience are not eligible.
